description:
Outcome: The coordinator sees unallocated applicants in original order and assigns the next household when a plot is available, from brief.md §Rules and item 2.
Scope: Durable waiting status, original timestamp/sequence order, head-only promotion using shared atomic allocation transaction and refreshed availability. Later applications join the queue by original submission order.
Excludes: Skipping waiters, preference/returning-status reordering and self-service plot release.
Acceptance: Promotion rejected before round finalization. No duplicate waiters; promotion removes exactly one waiter and preserves all allocation constraints. No available plot leaves queue unchanged. Priority never overrides FCFS after finalization.
Behaviour: Clear empty/no-availability states; stale/concurrent promotion rejected safely with refresh/retry.
Verification: Queue ordering after restart; before-finalization rejection; simultaneous promotion and submission/finalization boundary tests; verify no returning or preference reorder.
Prerequisites: T-006, T-007, T-008.
Assumptions: Vacancies and corrections use T-015 audited coordinator procedure; original submission order remains authoritative.
title: Implement strict FCFS waiting list and promotion
